area: Bromley-by-Bow / Poplar west of the Lea: Limehouse Cut towing path and North London Railway bridge, Bell Wharf, St Leonard's Road and Avenue, Wyvis/Yattan/Zetland/Uamvar Streets, Fawe Street, St Gabriel's
method: Sweep crops r0c0-r2c2 all displayed and anchored at opening (r0c0 LIMEHOUSE lettering, Towing Path, Bell Wharf; r0c1 PROSPECT PLACE, UAMVAR; r0c2 UAMVAR STREET, L.B.; r1c0 Dry Grain Works, FAWE STREET; r1c1 WYVIS/YATTAN STREET; r1c2 ZETLAND STREET; r2c0 St Gabriel's Church, RIFLE STREET; r2c1 ST LEONARD'S ROAD, CHADBOURN STREET; r2c2 ULLIN STREET, Mission House). Contact sheets c3_A, c3_B, c3_C (6x), c3_D (12x B.M. decimals), c3_E (8x digits), c3_F3 (10x smoothed + nearest, 5/6 test); region views c3_reg1 (2x Cut and towing path), c3_reg2 (6x pheon search for B.M.17·54), c3_reg3 (6x 17·6 dot). Every image displayed when opened. Dot centroids by numeric helper; positions checked on a marker sheet.
legibility: clear; horizontal sheet join py ~960 (tint line, full width; = py ~192 on 87158); interpunct dots in STREET, AVENUE and ST. LEONARD'S lettering make several survey dots ambiguous
